Full detail: ADR-010.

sprint.name: Dynamic Master-Site Authoritative-Page Discovery + Program Relevance Gate + Master Page Index & Multi-Target Orchestration
sprint.note: Implemented, tested, typecheck/build clean, code-reviewed (/code-review high, 5 findings), live-validated against two independent real master domains, committed and pushed (44395df). Four confirmed defects (C1-C4) found and fixed, each with a regression test, zero suite regressions. One real-world limitation (C5) acknowledged and documented, not fixed.

validation.code_review: /code-review high on full diff -- 5 findings, 4 confirmed defects (C1-C4) fixed, 1 (C5) acknowledged limitation
validation.c1_c4_status: fixed, each with a regression test, zero regressions
validation.c5_status: acknowledged real-world recall limitation on large non-university-shaped sites; related post-redirect domain-boundary gap also open; not fixed, safety gates not weakened
validation.online_manipal_live_validation: passed -- independent resolution confirmed per target, 1 irrelevant page correctly rejected, 1 duplicate correctly deduped
validation.non_online_manipal_live_validation: passed (correctness/safety properties held; recall lower on this site -- see C5) -- proves genericity, no institution-specific logic

components.apps/api: Thin Express HTTP adapter (POST /api/runs, GET /api/runs/:runId) over the existing, unmodified runMultiTargetDiscoveryAndComparison. No identity/program/comparison logic duplicated. In-memory RunStore behind an interface (persistence seam for later).
components.apps/dashboard: Vite + React + TypeScript SPA. New-run form, multi-target overview (scales generically, no hard-coded target list), per-target detail/audit view. Every real backend outcome/resolutionMethod/comparisonStatus value rendered via exhaustive lookup tables; detected-vs-policy-default institution identity visually distinct via the backend's own fallbackApplied flag.

frontend.tests: 71 new (17 apps/api, 54 apps/dashboard), 398 total across all 4 workspaces, zero regressions in the 327 backend tests
frontend.live_validation: Through the actual running API, real network, real Online Manipal site: 10-URL batch (4 success/1 ambiguous/5 not-found, matching prior backend-only validation exactly) and the 5-target MBA institution matrix (MAHE via url_identifier, SMU via combined_signals with a real matching logo asset, MUJ via url_identifier, generic /ln-mba via a real logo asset with fallbackApplied:false, MUJ's own canonical page via multi_university_default with fallbackApplied:true). Both real responses frozen as dashboard test fixtures and rendered through the actual TargetTable component (9 tests) to prove correct end-to-end rendering.
frontend.deviations_from_plan: Vite pinned to ^5.4.21 (vitest@2.1.4 depends on vite@^5 internally, not a peer -- avoids version-skew risk); react-router used instead of react-router-dom (unified successor package); deep import of modules/website-quality's build output instead of adding a package-level export, keeping the backend at zero changes. All recorded in ADR-011.
frontend.not_built_yet: Persistent run storage (RunStore is in-memory only, Phase 1, deliberately isolated behind an interface), run history/list view, scheduling, notifications.

modules.notes: Sprint 2/3/4/5/5B/4b and the D1 fix are all implemented, tested, live-validated, committed (3da02ce, 3dfabb8, 44395df), pushed to origin/main. apps/api and apps/dashboard (frontend) are implemented, tested, live-validated, and being committed/pushed together with this documentation update. modules.name: Marketing Asset Quality
modules.notes: General extension point, no directory yet.

known_issues: ln-pgcp-ei-mahe (one specific real URL) redirects (302) to the Master's bare homepage -- no reliable evidence exists there to resolve a specific program; correctly stays authoritative_page_not_found, investigated and documented, not fixed (not a resolution-logic defect -- a stale-URL/content problem on the real site).

Program Relevance Gate subject-overlap can still false-positive-tie across genuinely different subjects on the real Online Manipal site (ln-msc-ds-mahe) -- safe (ambiguous_candidates, never a wrong pick), same family as C5, not fixed.
PG-Certificate-style program naming (ln-pgcp-*) not recognized by degree-keywords.json -- an Understanding-layer (Sprint 2) gap.

Sprint 2 fact-extraction gaps confirmed still present on real pages: duration/mode/accreditation are frequently both_missing, and eligibility/fees occasionally capture a table-header label instead of the actual value, on some real Online Manipal pages. Pre-existing, unrelated to and unaffected by the D1 fix or the frontend work.

Institution vs. brand conflation (Sprint 2) is mitigated for REGISTERED institutions by Sprint 3's brand-alias fallback in resolveSource. Unregistered institutions still correctly report no_registry_entry, not a guess.

Heading-scoped claim extraction can grab a short label instead of the full sentence on real pages with nested sub-headings. Unrelated to Sprint 3/4/4b/5/5B/D1/frontend; still open, best-effort per Sprint 2's stated scope.

C5 (Sprint 5/5B, acknowledged, not fixed): real-world recall limitation on large, non-university-shaped sites -- system still never guesses wrong. Related, still-open gap: a same-domain candidate URL that redirects off-domain mid-fetch isn't re-checked against the domain boundary on its post-redirect destination.

A residual D1-adjacent gap remains, by design, for a target whose ONLY institution/brand signal (across URL, page text, and logo) is the generic shared brand identical to the wrong institution's own signal -- text/logo-based corroboration cannot distinguish that narrow case; closing it fully needs full MAHE/SMU Source registration or deeper extraction, both still open decisions.

apps/dashboard's dependency tree carries a known, dev-server-only esbuild advisory inherent to the Vite 5.x line vitest@2.1.4 requires -- a deliberate, documented trade-off (ADR-011), not a production risk.
apps/api's RunStore is in-memory only -- lost on process restart, no run history/list view yet. Explicit Phase 1 scope, isolated behind an interface for a later persistent implementation.

Memory-file staleness has recurred multiple times across sessions -- always caught by cross-checking git log/git status/source directly rather than trusting memory at face value. Continue doing that at the start of every session.
next_action: Backend (Sprint 2-5B, 4b, D1 fix) and frontend (apps/api, apps/dashboard) are both implemented, tested (398 tests), live-validated against the real Online Manipal site, and committed/pushed. No implementation gate remains open. Next: user decides priorities among persistent run storage, scheduling/notifications, the residual D1-adjacent gap, C5, or Sprint 6 scoping.
